title: About Memoire
description: A memory-evoking game that strengthens cognitive engagement and connection through conversation for those facing dementia.

items.title: 🎮 Play Together
items.description: Guide and encourage your co-player, but enjoy the game as equals. Take turns and make it a shared experience.

items.title: ⚖️ No Right or Wrong Way
items.description: Use the game as a starting point for fun and conversation. Let memories and emotions guide the experience.

items.title: 💬 Engage in Conversations
items.description: Ask one question at a time and share your own stories too. Meaningful moments come from connection.
